PRADYUM RAJ DEVENDRARAJ Bangalore, India | +91 9940141192 | pradyumraj.raj12@gmail.com | LinkedIn: pradyumraj

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Business Systems Analyst with nearly 5 years of experience across financial services, investment banking , enterprise operations, automation, reporting, dashboards, and process improvement. Skilled in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, AS-IS/TO-BE process mapping, SQL, Python, pandas, NumPy, APIs, Power BI, Excel, ServiceNow, JIRA, and Confluence. Experienced in translating business needs into scalable workflows, analytical dashboards, automation solutions, and data-driven operational improvements. Hands-on exposure to prompt engineering, Microsoft 365 Copilot agent prototyping, and AI-assisted dashboard tracking.

CORE SKILLS Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Stakeholder Management, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, BRD/FRD Support, AS-IS/TO-BE Mapping, Workflow Analysis, Functional Specifications Data & Analytics: SQL Joins, Data Extraction, Data Validation, Operational Data Analysis, Trend Analysis, KPI Reporting, RCA, Dashboarding, Business Performance Analysis Tools & Reporting: Power BI, Advanced Excel, Pivot Tables, Excel Macros, ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, Lucidchart, Microsoft 365 Copilot Technical Skills: Python, pandas, NumPy, APIs, YAML, SQL, Git, Docker, AWS, Basic CI/CD, Prompt Engineering, OpenAI/LLM Tools,UAT Domain Exposure: Financial Services, Investment Banking Support, Enterprise Operations, Access Governance, Risk & Control Awareness, Infrastructure Operations

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst | Accenture | Client: Morgan Stanley

Oct 2024 - June 2026

Gather business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional specifications, process flows, workflow rules, and validation logic supporting Investment Banking and Trade Lifecycle workflows across internal financial-services platforms.. Built financial tracking models and derived actionable insights from financial data to investment decisions and capital allocation Owned end-to-end business analysis deliverables including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, AS-IS/TO-BE documentation, and requirement traceability throughout the SDLC. Analyze form usage data, workflow patterns, ticket trends, request volumes, approval flows, and operational gaps to identify improvement opportunities and support data-driven decision-making. Build and enhance workflow automation using Python, YAML, APIs, and ServiceNow integrations, improving request validation, approval routing, exception handling, and operational tracking. Use Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, and Excel to clean, validate, analyze, and summarize operational data for usage reports, dashboards, and stakeholder updates. ● Created Power BI / Excel-based dashboards and reporting views to track form usage, request patterns, automation performance, and operational KPIs. ● Worked on a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent prototype for dashboard tracking and form usage insights, applying prompt engineering to enable quicker access to



●











operational metrics and business context. Contributed to Deco-Pilot, an internal automation tool used by 100+ users, enabling validation support for 1,000+ servers and reducing repetitive manual validation effort by approximately 60%. Collaborate with developers, business users, support teams, and senior stakeholders to clarify requirements, validate fixes, resolve production issues, prepare runbooks, and support release readiness.

Apr 2022 - Aug 2024 ● Worked in a hybrid Business Systems Analyst supporting enterprise applications, infrastructure workflows, operational reporting, and process improvement

Business Systems Analyst| Mphasis | Client: CBRE













initiatives. Analyzed service requests, change tickets, SLA trends, recurring issues, and operational bottlenecks to identify process gaps, automation opportunities, and reporting improvements. Partnered with application support, infrastructure, business operations, and engineering teams to document requirements, validate issues, coordinate fixes, and improve operational support processes. Built automation scripts, reports, and tracking solutions using Python, SQL, Excel macros, and Power BI to improve reporting accuracy, reduce manual effort, and increase operational visibility. Used SQL joins, filters, aggregations, and validation queries to investigate operational data, reconcile records, support reporting needs, and validate issue patterns. Supported AWS and DevOps-related activities involving AWS services, Docker, deployment support, monitoring, access coordination, and environment-level troubleshooting. Improved ticket closure SLA adherence by approximately 20% and reduced recurring reporting effort by around 30% through runbooks, automation, trackers, and standardized reporting templates.





●

Jun 2021 - Apr 2022 PeopleSoft Security Support Analyst | Mphasis | Client: CBRE Managed PeopleSoft security support activities including user access provisioning, role modification, access validation, permission issue analysis,and SLA tracking. Coordinated with business users, application teams, and technical stakeholders to validate access requirements, resolve permission issues, and support compliance-oriented access review activities. Analyzed access request patterns, recurring permission issues, and ticket data to improve request handling, documentation quality, and turnaround time. Improved access request turnaround time by approximately 25% through structured validation, documentation, and ticket tracking.

PROJECTS

Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Prototype - Form Usage Dashboard Tracking | Internal Prototype / Work Exposure

Worked on a prototype using Microsoft 365 Copilot agent capabilities to help users retrieve dashboard insights and track form usage metrics through natural



language prompts. Applied prompt engineering, dashboard interpretation, operational metric tracking, and stakeholder use-case mapping to improve accessibility of reporting insights.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATION MBA - Business Analysis | Loyola Institute of Business Administration, Chennai | Pursuing B.E. - Computer Science | Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai | 2017 - 2021 | CGPA: 7.8 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate - PL-300 | Valid until January 2027
